note: Map props (decisions 68–70). tags (decision 115): the type tags each piece can carry in `tags`; autoTags are worked out from the record (rules/props.js → tagsOf), never typed. Each record describes one SVG in app/props/: size in squares (w across, h deep, as drawn: the top edge of the drawing is the back), and what it does on the map. blocksMove: nobody walks through it. difficult: squares it covers cost 2 to enter (manual 7-2). blocksSight: lines of sight stop at it. cover: what someone behind it gets (hint only: the GM confirms). hiddenByDefault: placed hidden (GM-only until revealed). Hidden props have no effect until revealed. category = Library group and colour. tint: red / green / blue / purple / cyan / yellow overrides the colour. sensor: { senses, reach } (decision 69). power: 'public' (lights: players see on / off) or 'private' (keypad: GM-only, like sensors). openable: open / closed like a door, players see it (SVG groups class open-only / closed-only). flags: extra GM-only booleans kept for later rules. blockEdges: ['back', 'right', 'front', 'left'] — sides of the piece (as drawn) nobody crosses, while the rest stays open (stairs: on at the ends only; elevators: through the doors only); sight isn't blocked. Categories floor, terrain and scene are drawn under everything else. light: { radius } — an on light lights the squares within that many squares that it can see (decision 74). zone: 'dark' — a GM-only tile whose squares are dark even in a bright environment; gmOnly: never sent to players. `library` (decision 98): the builder's two-level Library — each group lists categories, or sets (a piece with `set` lives only in its set's group).
